exposure: Age of neonate (in days since birth)
cohort: 700 full-term, healthy infants were chosen randomly within 10 days of birth from hospitals in Anhui province.
finding: The retinal artery and vein diameters and arteriovenous ratio (AVR) in neonates exhibit dynamic changes during the first 10 days of life, with the AVR showing the most dramatic daily change and being considerably smaller than in adults.
cross-section timing: Within 1 to 10 days of birth, grouped into 7 age-based groups
